summary: T1 item 10 (repo hygiene): audited inventory binding README.md (what the block is, spec section 3 target/stretch table, reproduction instructions), LICENSE (Apache-2.0), spec/gate-driver.md and .github/workflows/ci.yml by sha256. The audit read these files and executed only lightweight checks (run_corners.py --check-env/--list, check_records.py, README link existence); no simulation, netlisting or layout flow was re-run and CI was read, not observed.
